title: Bosnia and Herzegovina (Republika Srpska) — Report of a Lost or Stolen Travel Document, Filed Abroad (Obrazac GPI-2)
description: The Ministry of Interior of Republika Srpska's (Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova Republike Srpske, MUP RS) Obrazac GPI-2, "Prijava nestanka putne isprave/putovnice (ukradena, izgubljena)" (Report of Loss of a Travel Document/Passport (stolen, lost)) — the companion, abroad-filing variant of ba/mup-rs/lost-or-stolen-travel-document-report@1.0.0 (Obrazac GPI-1), disclosed as open backlog when that schema opened Bosnia and Herzegovina's Passport vertical (GOV-4720). Where GPI-1 is filed with a domestic Republika Srpska police authority, this GPI-2 form is filed instead with a Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic-consular mission (DKP, diplomatsko-konzularno predstavništvo) abroad, to declare a travel document (most commonly an ordinary passport, putovnica) lost or stolen while the holder is outside the country; MUP RS's own instructions state this form may also be used to declare a travel document void. Field-for-field, this form is identical to GPI-1 except: the header addresses the report to a DKP rather than a domestic authority; the loss-location item asks for place *and country* of loss, rather than place alone (relevant only when reporting from abroad); and Section 4 adds one field not present on GPI-1, the domestic or foreign authority to which the loss/theft was itself first reported (distinct from the DKP the report is filed with). Republika Srpska is one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's two constituent entities (the other being the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, plus the Brčko District); this schema is scoped to Republika Srpska only, consistent with its sibling schemas. This v1.0.0 models the applicant-facing fields only (the form's own closing Section 5, headed "popunjava DKP" (completed by the DKP), is authority-populated and out of scope). GovSchema is an independent, non-profit standards body and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Government of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Government of Republika Srpska, or MUP RS.

authority.name: Министарство унутрашњих послова Републике Српске (Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova Republike Srpske, Ministry of Interior of Republika Srpska)

verification.notes: GOV-4811 ("GovSchema Standard Research"). Authors the GPI-2 companion schema disclosed as open backlog by GOV-4720's own ba/mup-rs/lost-or-stolen-travel-document-report@1.0.0 (GPI-1). A second schema within Bosnia and Herzegovina's already-open Passport vertical (5 of 6 open since GOV-4741), not a new vertical. See this document's own VERIFICATION.md for the full sourcing record, extraction method, and every disclosed scoping/judgment call.

fields.name: reporterFullName
fields.label: Ime i prezime podnosioca prijave (Full name of the person filing the report)
fields.description: The person submitting this report — the travel document's holder, or another person filing on the holder's behalf (e.g. a parent reporting for a minor child).

fields.name: receivingMissionName
fields.label: Naziv DKP kome se prijava podnosi (Name of the diplomatic-consular mission to which the report is submitted)
fields.description: The Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic-consular mission (DKP) abroad the applicant is addressing this report to. Distinct from GPI-1's receivingAuthorityName, which addresses a domestic police authority instead.

fields.name: documentStatus
fields.label: Putna isprava/putovnica je (The travel document/passport is)
fields.description: Whether the missing travel document was lost or stolen.
fields.sourceRef: Obrazac GPI-2 page 1, Section 4, checkbox pair

fields.name: holderPersonalId
fields.label: JMB (Holder's unique master citizen number)
fields.description: Personal identifier; handle as sensitive data. The travel document holder's JMBG-style unique master citizen number.

fields.name: holderFirstName
fields.label: Ime (Holder's first name)
fields.description: Personal identifier; handle as sensitive data.

fields.name: holderLastName
fields.label: Prezime (Holder's last name)
fields.description: Personal identifier; handle as sensitive data.

fields.name: holderParentName
fields.label: Ime jednog roditelja (Name of one parent of the holder)
fields.description: Personal identifier; handle as sensitive data. Used by MUP RS as an additional identifying particular of the holder.

fields.name: holderDateOfBirth
fields.label: Datum rođenja (Holder's date of birth)
fields.description: Personal identifier; handle as sensitive data. YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: holderPlaceAndCountryOfBirth
fields.label: Mjesto i država rođenja (Holder's place and country of birth)
fields.description: The form prints place and country of birth as a single combined item with one answer line.

fields.name: holderPermanentAddress
fields.label: Adresa prebivališta nosioca (Holder's permanent-residence address)
fields.description: Street address of the holder's permanent residence (prebivalište).

fields.name: holderPermanentAddressPlace
fields.label: Mjesto prebivališta nosioca (Holder's permanent-residence place)
fields.description: Town/municipality of the holder's permanent residence.

fields.name: holderTemporaryAddress
fields.label: Adresa boravišta nosioca (Holder's temporary-residence address)
fields.description: Street address of the holder's temporary residence (boravište), if different from the permanent residence.

fields.name: holderTemporaryAddressPlace
fields.label: Mjesto boravišta nosioca (Holder's temporary-residence place)
fields.description: Town/municipality of the holder's temporary residence, if different from the permanent residence.

fields.name: issuingAuthority
fields.label: Organ koji je izdao nestalu putnu ispravu/putovnicu (Authority that issued the missing travel document)
fields.description: The authority that originally issued the now-missing travel document.

fields.name: dateOfLoss
fields.label: Datum nestanka putne isprave/putovnice (Date the travel document was lost or stolen)
fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: placeAndCountryOfLoss
fields.label: Mjesto i država nestanke putne isprave/putovnice (Place and country the travel document was lost or stolen)
fields.description: Where the loss or theft occurred, including the country — unlike GPI-1's placeOfLoss, which asks for place alone, since GPI-1 is filed domestically and this GPI-2 variant is filed while the holder is abroad.

fields.name: authorityLossReportedTo
fields.label: Organ kome je prijavljen nestanak putne isprave/putovnice (Authority to which the loss/theft was itself reported)
fields.description: The (typically foreign, e.g. local police) authority to which the applicant first reported the loss or theft, distinct from the DKP this GPI-2 form is being filed with (receivingMissionName). This field has no counterpart on GPI-1.

fields.name: circumstancesDescription
fields.label: Opis okolnosti nestanka putne isprave/putovnice (Description of the circumstances of the loss or theft)
fields.description: Free-text account of how the travel document came to be lost or stolen. The form provides a ruled area on page 2 for this answer.

fields.name: filingPlace
fields.label: Mjesto podnošenja prijave (Place the report is filed)
fields.description: The place (city abroad) where the applicant is filing this report.

fields.name: filingDate
fields.label: Datum podnošenja prijave (Date the report is filed)
fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: reporterIdCardNumber
fields.label: LK/OI broj (Reporting person's ID card number)
fields.description: Personal identifier; handle as sensitive data. The identity-card number of the person filing this report (lična karta/osobna iskaznica).

fields.name: reporterIdCardIssuedBy
fields.label: LK/OI izdao (Authority that issued the reporting person's ID card)
fields.description: The authority that issued the identity card given in reporterIdCardNumber.
